latest_news.headline: Iran formally rejects US 15-point ceasefire plan, issues 5-point counterproposal
latest_news.text: Iran state TV announces formal rejection of US plan. Counterproposal demands: (1) war reparations, (2) Hormuz sovereignty recognition, (3) end to sanctions, (4) withdrawal from Gulf bases, (5) apology. Massive gap with US demands. But White House says plan 'never confirmed' and calls rejection narrative 'speculative.'

latest_news.headline: White House denies Iran rejected plan: 'they have not' — plan details 'speculative'
latest_news.text: Press Secretary Leavitt pushes back on rejection narrative. Says Trump 'willing to listen' and engaged in 'constructive discussions.' Plan details reported by media called 'not entirely factual.' Both sides now denying the rejection narrative exists.

latest_news.headline: Pakistan formally delivers Trump's 15-point plan to Iran — Sharif 'ready and honoured'
latest_news.text: PM Shehbaz Sharif confirms Pakistan delivered US ceasefire proposal to Iran via diplomatic channels. Islamabad 'ready and honoured to facilitate meaningful and conclusive talks' if both sides agree.

latest_news.headline: IAEA head Grossi: 'Talks this weekend in Islamabad' — first concrete timeline
latest_news.text: IAEA Director General Grossi tells Italian paper he thinks US-Iran talks could happen this weekend in Islamabad. First specific timeline given by senior official. Pakistan mediation advancing.
